# InviteEmailResponse

The result of re-sending an invite's e-mail. A failed send leaves the invite valid and acceptable, so it is reported here rather than as an error.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `inviteId` | `uuid` | The invite's id. |
| `emailSent` | `boolean` | False when the e-mail could not be sent. |
| `inviteUrl` | `string \| null` | The link that accepts the invite, so you can pass it on another way. Set only when the e-mail of an invite into the tenant could not be sent; null otherwise. |

## Example

```json
{
  "inviteId": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
  "emailSent": false,
  "inviteUrl": "..."
}
```
